fullScene:
Edit Image 1 as a single, coherent full-scene illustration for the existing interactive paper-theatre website. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for how the box is constructed and its attached rear-hinged lid, not its photography or bright color scheme.
Keep the exact wide 1672:941 canvas, viewpoint, framing, all existing objects and their positions, the quiet dusty rose / slate blue / sage palette, matte painted paper grain, softly layered cut-paper edges, and gentle light of Image 1. Make only these two changes.

1. SMALL THEATRE INTERIOR. Completely remove the two comedy/tragedy masks, wreath and bow. Paint ONE charming, modest vintage popcorn carton filled with irregular ivory popcorn directly into this little theatre scene, centered on the small interior stage. It is a handmade paper prop with subtle dusty rose and parchment stripes, delicate hand-painted folds and small natural shadows, with no text, no logo, no face. The popcorn is sculptural layered painted paper, not a glossy emoji or flat vector icon. Each popped kernel has an irregular believable shape. The carton rests on the tiny stage floor, not floating on the wall. Its overall silhouette occupies approximately x462–568, y490–637 on a 1672×941 canvas so the lateral moving curtains can reveal it. Keep the surrounding plain mauve rear wall, wooden arch, upper scalloped valance, canopy, exact inner jambs and floor in place. The theatre, its popcorn, its wall and lighting must be painted together as one whole image, never a separately pasted popcorn.

2. LOWER-CENTRE TAROT BOX. Keep the existing rectangular floral-covered paper box body, its size, its location and all four top rim corners exactly. Give it a physically attached rear-hinged lid like Image 2. The lid is connected along the entire back long edge, from about (508,703) to (697,655). It opens backward/upward roughly 100 degrees; its free top edge runs approximately (486,550) to (675,502). The lower edge of the lid MUST touch the box hinge with no detached or hovering gap. The lid has the same width as that long edge and the same depth as the box opening. Its inside is muted lilac cloth/paper with a fine, restrained aged cream lace border; use the same subtly painted material texture, not shiny upholstery or photography. Keep floral dusty pink and sage covering on the narrow outer rim, clear realistic paper thickness, visible continuous hinge crease, believable perspective. The lid does not cover the popcorn. The box interior remains EMPTY for animated cards to be added by the existing website. Do not paint extra cards in it. Do not add loose ribbons.
Do NOT add a bird, an envelope, moving green pear, lower theatre curtains, bookmark or any new foreground petal; these moving pieces already exist in the website and are deliberately absent in this background plate.
Do NOT change the castle or its window positions, book or flat moth cover pattern, basket or its woven front rim, flowers, leaves, steps, sky or outer curtains. No green annotations, interface, words or added symbols. Deliver one finished full wide scene.
animationCleanPlate:
Create an animation clean plate by editing Image 1. Preserve the exact full 1672:941 scene, composition, colors, textures and ALL details. Remove ONLY the upward-open lid of the floral tarot box in the lower centre. Remove the complete raised lid panel, rim and lace, roughly x532–754,y525–711 on the input canvas. Seamlessly reveal the original leaves, lower theatre jamb/steps and background behind it using Image 2 as a background structure reference.
Retain the entire open floral box body, exact rim and cavity with its continuous rear long edge from approximately (508,704) to (698,655). The box is simply temporarily lidless as an animation clean plate; do not close it or add any lid, flap, ribbons, cards, inserts or extra objects. Keep the clear inner surfaces and thin rim at the same coordinates as before.
CRITICAL: the wonderful popcorn carton and popcorn kernels already painted INSIDE the small theatre in Image 1 must remain exactly as in Image 1, with its original stage contact shadow, proportions and striped paper texture. Do not copy the masks or wreath from Image 2. No comedy/tragedy masks anywhere. Do not move or redraw the castle/windows, basket/rim/fruit, floor pear, flowers, moth book, outer curtains or theatre canopy. Do not add a bird, envelope, lower sliding curtains, bookmark or loose floor petal.
Deliver one coherent full wide background with popcorn already integrated into the little theatre. No separate icons or collage. This is an extremely local lid-removal edit, nothing else.
